question: On Selling a watch at 5/6 of the marked price there is a loss of 10 percent. What will be the ratio of the marked price and cost price of the watch?
solution:
**Given:**

Marked price (M.P) : selling price (S.P) = 6 : 5

Loss = 10%

**Concept used:**

S.P = C.P × (100 - L)%

Where, C.P = cost price

**Calculation:**

C.P : S.P = 100 : 90 = 10 : 9

M.P : S.P = 6 : 5

Selling price must be the same.

C.P : M.P : S.P = (10 × 5) : (6 × 9) : (9 × 5)

M.P : C.P = 54 : 50 = 27 : 25

**∴ The correct option is 2.**
